content.text: Let me build an ASan/UBSan instrumented version of the C core and stress it to catch any memory errors:

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && gcc -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -shared -fPIC -o /tmp/asan_core.so /app/submit/core.c 2>&1 | head -3; echo "build rc=$?"; python3 - << 'EOF'
import ctypes, array, random, os
lib = ctypes.CDLL('/tmp/asan_core.so')
lib.solve.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint64), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int), ctypes.c_int,
                      ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint64), ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int,
                      ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]
lib.solve.restype = ctypes.c_int
rng = random.Random(99)
def call(fib, caps, stride):
    n = len(fib); S = len(caps)
    flat = array.array('Q')
    for a, L, h in fib:
        flat.append(a >> 64); flat.append(a & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)
    lens = array.array('i', [t[1] for t in fib])
    if n == 0:
        flat.append(0); lens.append(0)
    capsa = array.array('Q', caps)
    a_ptr = (ctypes.c_uint64 * len(flat)).from_buffer(flat)
    l_ptr = (ctypes.c_int * len(lens)).from_buffer(lens)
    c_ptr = (ctypes.c_uint64 * len(capsa)).from_buffer(capsa)
    out = (ctypes.c_int * (S + 1))()
    rc = lib.solve(a_ptr, l_ptr, n, c_ptr, S, stride, out)
    return rc, list(out)
cases = 0
for trial in range(400):
    n = rng.randint(0, 80)
    fib = []; seen = set()
    while len(fib) < n:
        L = rng.randint(0, 128)
        a = rng.getrandbits(128)
        a = 0 if L == 0 else a & (((1 << L) - 1) << (128 - L))
        if (a, L) in seen: continue
        seen.add((a, L)); fib.append((a, L, 1))
    S = rng.randint(4, 16); stride = rng.randint(1, 32)
    if S * stride < 128: stride = min(32, -(-128 // S))
    caps = [rng.randint(100, 100000) for _ in range(S)]
    rc, cuts = call(fib, caps, stride)
    assert rc in (0, 1), rc
    cases += 1
# extremes
rc, cuts = call([], [4096]*4, 32); print('empty fib:', rc, cuts)
rc, cuts = call([(0,0,1)], [4096]*16, 8); print('only /0:', rc, cuts)
deep = [((i << 117) | rng.getrandbits(117), 128, 1) for i in range(2048)]
rc, cuts = call(deep, [1000000000]*16, 32); print('2048 deep:', rc, cuts)
chain = [(0, L, 1) for L in range(0, 129)]
rc, cuts = call(chain, [1000000000]*16, 32); print('full chain:', rc, cuts)
rc, cuts = call(chain, [1000000000]*4, 32); print('full chain S=4:', rc, cuts)
rc, cuts = call(chain, [100000]*4, 32); print('chain tight caps:', rc, cuts)
print('ASAN/UBSAN stress cases:', cases, '+ extremes: all clean')
EOF
